description: Updates a Sentry organization member's organization-level role and team roles. The request sends an empty team roles list by default when team roles are omitted.

inputSchema.description: Request schema for updating an organization member's roles.

member_id.description: The ID of the member whose roles are to be updated.
member_id.title: Member Id

orgRole.description: Sets the member's new organization-level role (e.g., 'billing' for payments, 'member' for event access, 'manager' for project/team admin, 'owner' for full control). The 'admin' role is not assignable on Business/Enterprise plans; use `teamRoles` for granular admin tasks.
orgRole.title: OrgroleEnm

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization to which the member belongs.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

teamRoles.description: List of team role assignments (each object specifying `teamSlug` and `role`). This list completely replaces existing team roles. An empty list (default) removes the member from all teams. Team roles: `contributor` (views/acts on issues), `admin` (full team/project management).

items.description: Request schema for `TeamRoles`. Specifies a team and role assignment.

role.description: The team role to assign. `contributor` can view and act on issues; `admin` has full management access to the team's membership and projects.
role.title: Role

teamSlug.description: The slug identifier of the team to assign a role for.
teamSlug.title: Team Slug

items.title: TeamRolesRequest

teamRoles.title: Team Roles
